title: intcomma overflows on large Python integers
provenance: Evaluator-authored problem-only adaptation of the upstream PR description, retrieved 2026-10-05. Not an authenticated pre-fix issue snapshot. Solution text and comments omitted.
body: humanize.intcomma(10**400 + 123), with its default precision, raises OverflowError. Python integers of this size are valid inputs and should be formatted with thousands separators while preserving every digit. Handle both positive and negative integers beyond the floating-point range, including ordinary int subclasses. Preserve existing behavior for ordinary integers, numeric strings, decimals and non-finite values. This task concerns integer inputs with default precision; changes to numeric-string parsing or explicit decimal-place semantics are outside scope. Add regression tests.
